name: Thaumaturgy (The Green Path) — 2 Intermediate — Dance of Vines

system.description: You animate a mass of vegetation up to your own size, in your line of sight, by spending a Willpower Trait and concentrating. The plants act under your complete control for a number of rounds equal to half your permanent Mental Traits (round down), with Physical Traits equal to your current Willpower rating and a Brawl rating one lower than your own, typically inflicting two bashing damage or entangling foes. The plants cannot uproot themselves to move about, though their reach can extend some distance.
system.duration: Rounds equal to half permanent Mental Traits
